dataList.content:
... I don't understand.
……原因不明。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Stored in this armory are the very same gear my team and I have been using until just a few days ago.
这武器库内的物品都是几天前我和队员们使用过的装备。

I remember receiving a report that there were Abnormalities and Distortions that we were to exercise martial force to suppress.
不论是收到报告说出现了需要武力镇压的异想体与扭曲的记忆，

Upon hearing that, I came in here and packed a few ammo cans full of anti-Abnormality special rounds for the mission. I remember it as clearly as if it happened yesterday.
还是听到消息后，带着几箱对异想体用弹药出发的记忆都很鲜明。

So how come they are all so... faulty now?
但究竟为什么……一件能正常运作的装备都没有？

Sonar Interference Module... It's got a snapped actuator cable. Impact-distributive Attenuation Unit... It's not even here.
声波干涉模块的驱动连接断开……扩散型冲击衰减元件则是……被整个拔掉了吗。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Default Cognition Filter settings are all jacked up, too...
认知滤网的初始设置为什么是这样……
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
These were all functions that, while never used that frequently, were consequential enough that I was pushed to use them all at least once while on an operation.
明明没有频繁使用，战斗中必备的功能却全部无法运作。

Something about this smelled funny; it was too precise and intentional to be disregarded as a mere coincidence.
若称之为偶然，那未免也太过精确与饱含恶意了。

Almost as if... someone who possesses a comprehensive technical and tactical knowledge of each gear sabotaged them.
就好像……某个掌握装备详情以及战术脉络的人动了手脚。

What the hell is this?
这有可能吗？
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
Ma'am?
什么可能？

dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Couldn't you have kno— Hm. I don't suppose there was any reason for you to knock.
难道……不该先敲门吗。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
No, Ma'am. I did not knock, on account of this being an armory.
是。因为是武器库，所以就省略了。

... So, what is your business?
……所以呢，你有什么事？
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
A document for you, Ma'am.
有提交给您的文件。

dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content: It is a business letter... Latest-release Dimensional Container Issuance Logistics Notice, Ma'am. 是一份业务信件……内容是关于实施新型次元包发放手续的介绍。

Latest-release Dimensional Container...? Must be referring to the wallet model I saw in the pamphlets some time ago.
新型次元包……是指之前在宣传单上看过的那个钱包模型吗。

I do wonder if it really is necessary to replace that gear again, especially when the last renewal was but a month ago... But why not, I suppose.
虽然我上个月才更换过……但没理由拒绝。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
This company... is disgustingly rich.
这家公司……钱多到恶心。

I have no idea how they do it, but they keep picking up these partnerships with corporations and Workshops, even snagging the rights to internally distribute their yet-to-be-announced products as a test run...
要么是不断地和未知的地方建立着合作关系，要么是试点提供市面上尚未出现的工坊或是公司产品……

When I see them eagerly issuing us gears loaded with Singularity tech, which must've cost them a fortune in patent fees, it almost makes me wonder if they never even consider the idea of budgeting.
甚至像是完全不考虑巨额专利使用费一样，积极运用着使用了其他翼的奇点技术的装备。
Even the gears in this armory are all high-quality—no, they're not just high-quality, they're extravagantly top-notch. 仅仅看这武器库里的装备，每一样都是上等……不，说是奢侈品也不为过。

Very well. Leave it on my desk, and...
放在桌子上……
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
... Hold on. Do you know who was responsible for running the last gear inspection?
等等。你知道之前负责装备检修的是谁吗？
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
Of this armory? Technicians sent directly by the higher-ups in the LCA, Ma'am. They came in a few days ago to test their functionalities.
我们这边吗？几天前，LCA高层派来了技术人员进行功能检修。

From the HQ?
从本部吗？
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
Yes, Ma'am. Ah, by any chance, would you like us to run an inspection of our own—
是的。没错。啊，难道您……是需要我们另外检修……

... No, don't worry about it. They already ran an inspection just a few days ago anyway; no need to concern yourselves with doing it again.
……不，前几天才检修过，你们没必要为此费心。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Anyway... How's the situation down at the research facility?
先不管这个……研究所的情况如何？
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
According to the transmission from the Before Team, it seems to me they're having a hard time getting a clear picture of what's happening within the facility.
只靠从先遣部队的无线电里听到的部分，似乎还很难准确掌握情况。

dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
Regardless, the word is that the Recon team of the special operations unit might be getting deployed soon.
不过据说特战小组的侦察部队很快就要投入行动了。

The special operations unit? Are the portals working again?
特殊作战小组？传送门又能运作了吗？
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
No, Ma'am.
不是。

Strange. The HQ's response is too tepid, considering it's the Research Facility of the LCE under attack.
尽管LCE研究所受到了袭击，本部的反应却太过冷淡。

Even stranger still, Wayfarer Corp., responsible for the development and service of the Backdoor Portal stabilization technology for the HQ, hasn't reacted in any meaningful way to this rather serious breach of security.
更为奇妙的是，即使发生了这等安全事故，研发并向本部提供了后门入口稳定技术的<ruby=Wayfarer>旅者</ruby>公司却毫无反应。

Perhaps they've already talked this out with the higher-ups, but...
虽然不排除高层部门已经与其进行过协商的可能……

... Either way, this isn't something a mere Team Leader like myself should rack her head over.
……但这也并非身为一介队长的我应该思考的问题。

dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
Would you like us to go on standby for deployment, just in case?
以防万一，我们需要保持待机吗？

Ha. Say it like you mean it next time.
呵。话里都没带感情。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Just take it easy for now.
适当休息吧。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
Yes, Ma'am.
明白。

... I should inspect the rest of the gear in here.
……继续检修剩下的装备吧。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Hmm...
唔……
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
... And that's everything.
……结束了。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
So, the HQ employees left these gears in such states of disrepair, huh...
让本部的人员进行检修……就这种结果吗。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
But they've left these too neatly organized afterward to chalk it up to mere negligence.
要说是疏漏……也未免太过利落了。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
What could this shady company possibly be planning now...?
这家阴险的公司……又在谋划什么。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
After the Smoke War came to a close...
烟霾战争结束之后。

... I wandered for a while, unable to find a place to settle. Until, one day...
无处扎根、彷徨无所的我……

... I was scouted by a rather peculiar Grade-1 Fixer Office, which has mysteriously maintained its grade despite its rather middling fame and performance, via a mutual acquaintance connection.
经熟人介绍，被挖去了一家奇妙的收尾人事务所，虽然名声与实绩都十分模糊，但却莫名保持在1阶。

The terms of the contract, which were delivered to me with a heads-up that we would later be a part of a corporation called "Limbus Company," were almost unbelievably lucrative.
并且以后将归属到名为边狱公司的企业之中，那时与介绍一同递来的合同上的条件好到令人难以置信。

Although the role I was to take was that of a simple team leader at a company I had only just heard of, I was offered with an eye-watering salary...
只是一所名不见经传的公司里的一个连指挥官都不是的队长，却也有高额的薪水……

... and those assigned under my command were nothing less than what one would call "elite" operatives.
而分配给我的队员，无一不可称为精英。

Despite those incredible perks, there were moments when I could not help but feel a sudden chill running down my spine as I carried out the missions sent to us from the higher-ups.
但即使如此，在执行高层下派的任务时……还是偶尔令人毛骨悚然。

Our next mission... Seems to me we'll be sent to obliterate a Finger subsidiary known as "The House of Spiders."
下一份任务……听说是扫荡名为蜘蛛巢的手指下属帮派。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Yes, now is one such moment.
没错，正如现在这样。

There's this sudden chill again, that I might be getting swept up in a current much greater than myself.
仿佛被汹涌的奔流卷入一般，有种令人不适的感觉。

In the zone we're handling... ah. Looks like we'll be responsible for dealing with a... Proxy of the Index, who was once a Star of the City all on his own.
处在我们所负责的区域内的……是曾一度升为都市之星的食指代行者。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
... We're going to need a new strategy.
……需要重新修订战略。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员

dataList.content:
Udjat Talata, cover the gap on our left.
瓦吉特三号。补充左侧人员空缺。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
I'll take the right.
右侧由我来支援。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Tsk. We lost the target.
啧。跑了吗。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
Ma'am, how do you think the Proselytes found out about this place?
苦行者们怎么会知道这里？

Through the Prescripts. What else could it possibly be?
接到了指令吧。除此之外我想不到其他可能。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Among the Index members who crashed the fight, the ones wearing long capes went after the so-called "Index Nursefather" without engaging us.
闯入战局的食指中，披风明显较长的那些人并没有进行战斗，而是跟随被称为食指父辈之人离开了。

That Nursefather had a rather nasty, almost fatal wound...
虽然身受几乎致命的重伤……

... but assuming that the Index members who went after the Nursefather would provide appropriate medical assistance, survival was still a possibility.
但只要他们处理得当，应该不会伤及性命。

We suffered some heavy losses, but... this is a rather acceptable outcome.
出现了不少伤亡啊……不过这种程度还算好。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
dataList.teller:
Udjat Agent
瓦吉特 队员
dataList.content:
Numerous rarely-used functions and additional Workshop gear you brought to the mission really came in through the clutch in this operation, Ma'am.
队长您另外带来的工坊装备也是……平常战斗中不常使用的功能也相当有效。

... I thought preparing as wide a range of options as possible seemed to be the most apt countermeasure against an enemy that is difficult to predict, that is all.
……毕竟敌人无法预测，我只是认为对策应该越多越好。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
As for our deceased, collect their gear...
将阵亡队员的装备全部回收……
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
... and either incinerate or crush their faces.
尸体只烧毁面部，或者直接碾碎。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Well, then... time for the report.
那么……之后就只需要报告了。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Come in. This is LCA Vanguard Team, Udjat.
这里是LCA先锋队瓦吉特。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
Position secured, over.
目标占领完毕。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
LCA

dataList.content:
I sense it all in that slight exhale coming through the radio.
只是通过无线电传来的短促呼吸声也能听出来。

The surprise, followed by marvel. And through it all... an undercurrent of annoyance.
惊讶。感慨。以及……夹杂于其中的一丝烦躁。

The listener is impressed by the unexpected success...
是对这预料之外的成果感到佩服……
... but annoyed by the fact that the said success undermined the real intent behind the mission. 又或是对这结果与预期相悖的事实感到不快呢。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Is that so?
是吗。

... That might as well have been a confirmation of my suspicions.
……这样就可以确定了。

Now, I know who sabotaged our gears in the armory.
武器库里的装备是谁的手笔。

Any internal documents and bodies found on-site will be collected by the After Team.
内部资料与遗体预计由收尾部队进行回收。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队

dataList.content:
As for the handover of Relics to the LCA R&D team—
而发现的遗物将移交至LCA研究开发小组……
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
LCA
dataList.content:
We will be giving the Relic-handling task to a different party.
遗物会由我们另外安排人员进行配送。

... Understood.
……明白了。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
LCA
LCA
dataList.content:
Do you have any further questions?
还有其他问题吗？

... Negative.
……没有。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
LCA
dataList.content:
Listen, Team Leader.
队长啊。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Please keep up the good work. Exactly as you are doing now.
以后也请继续如此，拜托你了。

There were many questions to be explored upon my return, but...
虽然回去后要处理的问题堆积成山……

... at this moment, I had only one answer to mutter back into the radio.
但现在我能说的只有这一句。

... Understood.
……是。
dataList.title:
LCA Vanguard Team 3
LCA 先锋三队
